description: Remember a user decision or verified project fact, with optional source node citations. It takes effect immediately: the Playground agent reads remembered notes in every later turn, the same way it remembers what users tell it. Requires project edit access.

content.description: Memory text to propose for future creative work.

kind.description: Memory category used to organize the proposed guidance.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

scope.description: Scope in which to find or save the requested item.

sourceNodeIds.description: Canvas node IDs that provide evidence for the proposed memory.

name: playground_memory_propose
title: Remember a Playground project note
